concerns.text: FR-001 specifies that the dataset must be downloaded using `wget`. Task T001 uses `datasets.load_dataset` from HuggingFace, which deviates from the required method and constitutes a weakening of the functional requirement.

FR-003 requires a scaffold‑based split with explicit 80/10/10 train/val/test ratios. Task T003 only states generation of 5 × 5 scaffold splits without enforcing or verifying the required split ratios, thereby weakening the requirement.

SC-003 demands that attribution scores be validated against independent physical measurements. Task T008 only checks that ≥ 80 % of top‑10 nodes belong to conjugated substructures, which does not satisfy the external validation clause.
SC-004 (pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) is not covered by any task; there is no verification step that measures total end‑to‑end execution time, leaving the success criterion untestable.
SC-005 (peak RAM ≤ 7 GB) is also absent from the task list; no verification of memory usage is performed, violating the specification’s acceptance scenario.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires that every artifact carry a content hash. No task records or publishes these hashes; T012 validates contracts but does not generate the required hash logs, breaching the constitution.
The requirement‑to‑task mapping table references a non‑existent task “T017”, creating an orphan reference that may cause confusion.
